build_multinli_dataset: build the MultiNLI dataset by downloading and extracting data to the ParlAI datapath directory
download_multinli_resources: download the MultiNLI 1.0 zip file from NYU to the specified data path
check_multinli_built: check if the MultiNLI dataset has already been built at the given data path
remove_outdated_multinli: remove an older version of the MultiNLI dataset before rebuilding with the latest version
mark_multinli_done: mark the MultiNLI dataset build as complete with the current version string
